display.longDescription: 在 Ubuntu 实例里安装 Microsoft 官方 arm64 VS Code，并通过 Kite 内嵌 X11 桌面能力打开。

install.cmd:
set -e
if ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '当前实例缺少 apt-get，无法安装 VS Code'
  exit 127
fi
arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture 2>/dev/null || uname -m)"
case "$arch" in
  arm64|aarch64) ;;
  *) echo "VS Code 当前仅验证 arm64/aarch64，当前架构: $arch"; exit 1 ;;
esac
mkdir -p "$install_root" /workspace/.kf/cache/vscode-x11/extensions
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y wget gpg ca-certificates apt-transport-https xkb-data fonts-dejavu-core
install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
wget -qO- https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor > /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg
chmod 0644 /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg
printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code\nSuites: stable\nComponents: main\nArchitectures: arm64\nSigned-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.sources
apt-get update
apt-get install -y code
test -x /usr/bin/code || test -x /usr/share/code/code
code --version || true
echo 'VS Code installed for Kite embedded X11'

base.name: VS Code
base.description: 启动 VS Code 桌面版

recipe.cmd:
set -e
if ! command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'VS Code 还没有安装完整，请先点获取或重新获取。'; exit 127; fi
mkdir -p /workspace/.kf/cache/vscode-x11/extensions /workspace/.kf/runtime/vscode-x11/user-data
proxy="${KITE_DESKTOP_PROXY:-/workspace/.kf/bin/kite-open-desktop}"
if [ ! -x "$proxy" ]; then echo 'Kite X11 桌面代理不可用，请重新打开实例。'; exit 127; fi
"$proxy" "ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU=1 LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 GTK_USE_PORTAL=0 code --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --disable-dev-shm-usage --ozone-platform=x11 --user-data-dir=/workspace/.kf/runtime/vscode-x11/user-data --extensions-dir=/workspace/.kf/cache/vscode-x11/extensions /workspace"
